title: 25 Tips For Video Game PR || Audra Mclver
description: Communications specialists now need to think of PR from a global perspective rather than the old regional campaigns of old, and add social media strategies to the mix. Presented by Plan of Attack Co-Founders Chris Clarke and Audra McIver the session will cover the top 25 tips for a successful global communications campaign, to make sure your game rises above the competition, generates media coverage and on launch installs and sales at NGDC 2015.
